Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action action_type 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (target_dictionary.pref_name). Do not deduplicate.
